title: Late for a meeting
text: You are twenty minutes late for a project meeting with your manager, Mr. Shah, because your train was delayed. You have just walked into the room. Respond to the situation.
model: I'm sorry I'm late, Mr. Shah. My train was delayed. If you're ready, we can start now, and I'll catch up on anything I missed.

points.text: Offer to start or catch up

title: A damaged delivery
text: A customer calls you because the laptop they received has a cracked screen. You work in support. Respond to the customer.
model: I'm sorry the laptop arrived with a cracked screen. Could you please share the order number? I can arrange a replacement or a full refund.

title: A deadline you cannot meet
text: Your manager, Ms. Rao, asked for a report by Friday. You know the team cannot finish the testing in time. Speak to her about it.
model: I'm sorry, but we cannot finish the testing by Friday. The team still has several tests left. Could we extend the deadline to Monday, or add one more person to help?

points.text: Explain that Friday is too soon
Propose a new time or extra help

title: Asking for leave
text: You need three days of leave next week for a family wedding. Ask your team lead, Mr. Menon.
model: I would like to request three days of leave next week, from Monday to Wednesday, for a family wedding. I will finish the pending work, and a colleague will cover anything urgent.

points.text: Request the leave and the dates
Say how your work will be covered

title: A noisy neighbor at work
text: The person at the next desk is playing music on speakers during work. Politely ask them to use headphones.
model: I'm sorry to interrupt. The music on your speakers is a bit loud. Would you mind using headphones?

points.text: Ask them to use headphones or lower the volume

title: Thanking a colleague
text: Your colleague Neha stayed late to help you finish slides for a client. The client liked the presentation. Thank her in person.
model: Thank you, Neha. I really appreciate you staying late to help with the client slides. The client liked the presentation. Please let me know if I can return the favor.

points.text: Mention the presentation or the client

title: You sent the wrong file
text: You emailed the client the old price list instead of the new one. Call the client and correct the mistake.
model: I'm sorry. I sent the old price list by mistake. I'll send the correct updated file right away.

points.text: Explain that the old file was sent
Say you will send the correct file

title: Suggesting flexible hours
text: Many people on your team arrive late because of traffic. Suggest flexible start times to the HR manager, Ms. Kapoor.
model: Many people on the team arrive late because of traffic. I would like to suggest flexible start times. It could reduce stress and help people focus.

title: Duplicate supplier invoice
text: A supplier has charged your department twice for one shipment of printer paper. Speak to the Accounts Team about the situation.
model: We received two invoices for the same shipment, although only one delivery was recorded by our reception team. Both invoices show purchase order 614, and I have attached the delivery receipt and the two invoice copies for comparison. Please cancel the duplicate charge and send a corrected account statement before our next payment run.

title: Blocked emergency exit
text: Boxes from an office move have been left in front of the emergency exit on the second floor. Speak to the Facilities Manager about the situation.
model: The emergency exit on the second floor is blocked by several boxes, which could prevent staff from leaving safely during an evacuation. I have asked the moving team to keep the corridor clear and move the boxes into the designated storage area. Please arrange a daily corridor inspection this week and remind the contractors that emergency routes must remain unobstructed.

title: Customer data sent to the wrong address
text: A sales employee accidentally sent a customer contact list to an external address instead of an internal colleague. Speak to the Data Protection Team about the situation.
model: A customer contact list was sent to an incorrect external address, and the file contains names, telephone numbers, and business email addresses. The employee reported the mistake immediately, attempted to recall the message, and asked the recipient to delete the attachment without opening it. Please review the incident and advise us on any further reporting, customer communication, or access restrictions that may be necessary.

title: Accessible training venue
text: An employee who uses a wheelchair cannot access the upstairs room booked for next month's safety course. Speak to the Training Coordinator about the situation.
model: The current training room is upstairs and has no lift access, so one of our employees cannot attend the course there. The large ground-floor meeting room has step-free access, an accessible washroom nearby, and enough space for the planned practical exercises. Please move the course to that room and update the joining instructions before the invitations are issued.

title: Missing expense receipt
text: Your travel expense claim is missing the receipt for a taxi taken after a client visit. Speak to the Finance Manager about the situation.
model: The receipt for the taxi journey after my client visit is missing, although the payment appears in my bank statement. I have attached the card statement and the booking confirmation, which show the journey date, destination, and amount paid. Could you confirm whether this evidence is acceptable or tell me what alternative document I should obtain before submitting the claim?

title: Software licence renewal
text: The design software used by your team will stop working when its annual licence expires at the end of the month. Speak to the IT Procurement Team about the situation.
model: Our design software licence expires at the end of the month, and the team needs uninterrupted access for two ongoing client projects. We require six active user seats, while the two unused seats from last year's purchase can be removed from the renewal. Please obtain an updated quotation and begin the renewal process this week so that there is time for approval before expiry.

title: Interpreting a revised product specification
text: A revised specification for a customer portal gives two different limits for uploaded file sizes. Speak to the Product Manager about the situation.
model: The revised specification lists a ten-megabyte upload limit in the overview but a twenty-megabyte limit in the detailed requirements. We cannot complete the upload validation or write reliable test cases until the intended limit has been confirmed. Please confirm which limit applies and publish a single corrected version that both the development and testing teams can use.

title: Invitation to a supplier demonstration
text: Your company is considering a new stock-tracking system and wants the supplier to demonstrate it to warehouse staff. Speak to the Supplier Representative about the situation.
model: We would like to arrange a demonstration of your stock-tracking system so that our warehouse team can assess its suitability for daily operations. Please include barcode scanning, returned goods, and the procedure for recording stock when the internet connection is unavailable. Could you share your availability for a ninety-minute session next week and tell us whether a temporary trial account can be provided?

title: Water damage to archived files
text: A leaking pipe has damaged some paper files stored in your office archive. Speak to the Records Manager about the situation.
model: Water from a leaking pipe has soaked several boxes of archived paper files, although the electronic copies appear to be unaffected. We have moved the undamaged boxes to a dry room and kept the wet records separate so that specialist recovery work can be assessed. Please arrange an inspection and advise which records require professional recovery and which can be replaced from the electronic archive.

title: Visitor identity checks
text: Several visitors have entered a restricted office area without showing identification because the reception desk was busy. Speak to the Security Supervisor about the situation.
model: Several visitors reached the restricted office area without an identity check when reception was handling a large group arrival. We have asked hosts to collect their visitors from reception and ensure that each guest receives a badge before entering the work area. Please provide temporary reception support during group arrivals and review the sign-in procedure with the team.

title: Request for a project handover
text: You are taking over a project from a colleague who will leave the company in two weeks. Speak to the Project Lead about the situation.
model: I will take responsibility for the project when our colleague leaves, and I would like to arrange a structured handover before their final day. The handover should cover open tasks, key customer contacts, outstanding decisions, and the risks that need attention during the next release. Please schedule a handover session early next week and ask the outgoing colleague to share the current project documents beforehand.

title: Incorrect delivery address
text: A courier has taken a customer order to your old warehouse address even though the order showed your new address. Speak to the Logistics Coordinator about the situation.
model: The courier delivered the customer order to our old warehouse address, while the shipping instructions clearly show the new distribution centre. This error may delay the customer's installation, because the goods must be transferred before we can complete the final dispatch checks. Please arrange collection from the old warehouse today and confirm the time when the goods will reach the correct address.

title: Reducing unnecessary printed reports
text: Your team prints large weekly reports that most employees read on their laptops instead. Speak to the Office Manager about the situation.
model: Our weekly reports are printed for every employee, but most copies remain unused because the team reads the digital version on their laptops. I suggest distributing the report electronically and printing copies only when a team member specifically requests one. Could we trial this approach for one month and compare paper use, printing costs, and staff feedback before making a permanent change?

title: Meeting recording consent
text: A manager wants to record a workshop attended by staff and external guests, but the invitation did not mention recording. Speak to the Compliance Officer about the situation.
model: The manager would like to record the workshop for colleagues who cannot attend, but the original invitation did not tell the external guests about this. We should inform all participants in advance, explain who will be able to view the recording, and give them a way to raise concerns. Please advise us on the required consent wording and confirm how long the recording may be retained.

title: Equipment loan for a remote worker
text: A new remote employee has received a laptop but has no headset or external keyboard. Speak to the IT Service Desk about the situation.
model: The new employee has received a working laptop but still needs a headset and an external keyboard to complete calls and training comfortably. The employee is working from home, and their current delivery address and telephone number are included in the attached onboarding record. Please arrange a loan of both items and confirm the expected delivery date so that we can plan the remaining training sessions.

title: Extending a library loan for research
text: You need to keep a borrowed reference book for an extra week because your company research report is not finished. Speak to the Library Manager about the situation.
model: I would like to extend the loan of the supply-chain reference book for one additional week while I complete our research report. The supplier data arrived later than expected, and I still need to compare it with the examples in the final two chapters. Please let me know whether renewal is possible; if another reader has reserved the book, I will return it on the original due date.

points.text: Explain the reason for the delay

title: Changing a catering order
text: The number of people attending a company event has increased, and some new attendees have dietary restrictions. Speak to the Catering Manager about the situation.
model: The confirmed headcount for our event has increased from thirty to forty-two people, so we need to revise the original catering order. The revised list includes six vegetarian meals and two gluten-free meals, and one attendee has a severe nut allergy. Please send a revised menu and total cost, and confirm how the allergy information will be communicated to the kitchen staff.

title: Emergency cover for a customer help desk
text: Two members of the customer help desk are absent on a day when a product update is likely to generate extra calls. Speak to the Support Manager about the situation.
model: Two help-desk colleagues are absent today, leaving fewer staff available just as customers begin receiving the product update. I propose moving one trained colleague from the internal support queue and using staggered breaks to keep the customer phone line covered. Please approve this temporary arrangement and tell us which issues should be escalated directly to the product team.

title: Returning a faulty demonstration unit
text: A demonstration tablet sent by a supplier overheats during short presentations and needs to be returned safely. Speak to the Supplier Support Team about the situation.
model: The demonstration tablet becomes unusually hot after a short presentation and then shuts down, even when it is not connected to its charger. We observed the same problem during three tests using the supplied charger, and we have stopped using the device as a precaution. Please provide safe return instructions and arrange a replacement demonstration unit before our customer event.

title: Request for a salary correction
text: Your payslip does not include an agreed overtime payment for work completed during a weekend release. Speak to the Payroll Team about the situation.
model: My latest payslip does not include the approved overtime payment for the weekend release work completed earlier this month. I have attached the approved timesheet and the manager's email confirming the number of hours and the applicable payment rate. Please check the calculation and let me know when the missing amount can be paid or included in a corrected payslip.

title: Delayed approval for a marketing campaign
text: A campaign is ready to launch, but the final artwork is waiting for a decision from the legal team. Speak to the Marketing Director about the situation.
model: The campaign materials are ready, but the final artwork is still awaiting legal approval for the customer claims printed on the main banner. Unless the review is completed tomorrow, we will miss the agreed publishing slot and need to revise the launch schedule with our media partner. Please help us prioritise the legal review or confirm whether a version without the disputed claims may be released first.

title: Inviting staff to a mentoring programme
text: Your department wants to launch a voluntary mentoring programme for employees who have recently joined the company. Speak to the Human Resources Team about the situation.
model: We propose a voluntary mentoring programme to help recently joined employees understand their roles, build confidence, and find support across departments. Each mentor would meet their assigned colleague for one hour each month during the first six months, with brief guidance provided by Human Resources. Please invite experienced employees to volunteer and collect registrations before we match mentors with the new starters.

title: Requesting a quiet room for interviews
text: The open office is too noisy for a series of confidential recruitment interviews planned for next week. Speak to the Facilities Team about the situation.
model: We need a quiet room for next week's recruitment interviews because the discussions involve personal information and should not be overheard in the open office. The room should have a reliable video connection, a table, and four chairs, with access available throughout the scheduled interview blocks. Please reserve a suitable room and confirm its location so that we can include accurate joining details in the candidate invitations.

title: Correcting an error in a published timetable
text: The timetable posted on the company website lists the wrong start time for a staff seminar. Speak to the Events Coordinator about the situation.
model: The timetable on the company website shows the seminar starting at ten, while the approved programme and speaker booking both specify eleven. We should update the website immediately and send a short correction to everyone who has already registered for the seminar. Please confirm who will make each update and check the final timetable against the speaker's booking before it is republished.

title: Request for a supplier sustainability report
text: Your company is reviewing the environmental performance of the suppliers used for office furniture. Speak to the Purchasing Manager about the situation.
model: We are reviewing the environmental performance of our furniture suppliers before deciding whether to renew the current purchasing agreement. The review needs evidence about responsibly sourced materials, packaging recycling, and the emissions associated with manufacturing and delivery. Please request the latest sustainability report and supporting certificates from the supplier by the end of next week.

title: Reporting a successful pilot project
text: Your team has completed a small trial of an automatic appointment reminder system and needs to report the results. Speak to the Department Head about the situation.
model: The reminder trial reduced missed appointments, and staff reported that fewer customers needed a telephone call to confirm their booking. The main limitation was that reminders could not be delivered when customer mobile numbers were missing or entered incorrectly. I recommend extending the trial to another branch after we update the contact records and add a check for invalid telephone numbers.

title: Adjusting a warehouse shift pattern
text: The warehouse receives most deliveries early in the morning, but the current staffing pattern leaves too few people available then. Speak to the Operations Manager about the situation.
model: Most deliveries arrive before nine in the morning, while the current shift pattern provides its lowest staffing level during that period. I suggest moving the start time of one team forward by an hour and creating a short overlap between the early and regular shifts. Please review the proposal with the affected staff and approve a two-week trial if the revised arrangement is acceptable.

title: Requesting a lost property search
text: You left a folder containing interview notes in a meeting room and could not find it when you returned. Speak to the Building Reception about the situation.
model: A blue folder containing interview notes was left in the small meeting room after yesterday's afternoon recruitment session. I checked the room and the reception cupboard this morning, but it was not there; the evening cleaning team may have moved it. Please contact the cleaning team and keep the folder in a secure place if it is found, since the notes contain personal information.

title: Explaining a budget variance
text: Your project has spent more on travel than originally planned because two customer visits were added late in the month. Speak to the Finance Director about the situation.
model: Travel spending exceeded the original budget after the customer requested two additional site visits that were not included in the project plan. The visits allowed the team to resolve installation issues on site and prevented a longer interruption to the customer's normal operations. We will update the monthly forecast and seek approval before arranging any further unplanned travel so that future costs remain visible.

title: Organising a charity collection
text: Your office wants to collect useful supplies for a local food bank without disrupting normal work. Speak to the Community Coordinator about the situation.
model: We would like to organise a voluntary collection of suitable supplies for the local food bank during the final week of this month. Staff can leave sealed, in-date food items in the labelled collection boxes beside reception, and the charity has provided a list of its current needs. Please approve the use of that space and allow us to circulate a short announcement explaining the collection dates and accepted items.

title: Reviewing a customer refund request
text: A customer has asked for a refund after receiving a service that was shorter than the package they paid for. Speak to the Customer Service Manager about the situation.
model: The customer paid for a full two-hour service, but the visit ended after seventy-five minutes without completing all the work listed in the package. The booking record and the technician's report confirm the early finish, and the customer has sent photographs of the unfinished work. I recommend offering either a partial refund or a free return visit, according to the customer's preference and our service policy.

title: Approving a translation of safety instructions
text: Some employees cannot easily understand the English instructions supplied with a newly installed machine. Speak to the Safety Officer about the situation.
model: Several employees are having difficulty understanding the English safety instructions for the new machine, which may affect their ability to operate it safely. We propose a checked translation of the essential instructions and a practical demonstration led by a trained operator before the machine is used independently. Please review the translated version and confirm that it accurately explains the hazards, emergency stop procedure, and required protective equipment.

title: Request for a flexible payment schedule
text: Your company wants to split payment for a large equipment order into two instalments while keeping the agreed delivery date. Speak to the Supplier Accounts Team about the situation.
model: We would like to divide the payment for the equipment order into two instalments because the purchase is larger than our usual monthly spending. We propose paying half when the order is confirmed and the remaining balance within thirty days of delivery, while keeping the existing delivery date. Please confirm whether you can accept these terms and send an updated order acknowledgement showing the revised payment schedule.

title: Updating a staff emergency contact list
text: A recent drill showed that several employees' emergency telephone numbers are out of date. Speak to the Human Resources Manager about the situation.
model: During the recent drill, several emergency contact numbers could not be reached because the details in our staff records were out of date. We suggest asking every employee to verify their details using a secure update form, with access limited to the authorised Human Resources team. Please approve a two-week completion period and arrange a reminder for anyone whose record has not been confirmed by the deadline.

title: Preparing for an external audit
text: Your department will be audited next month, and the evidence requested by the auditor is stored in several locations. Speak to the Quality Manager about the situation.
model: The auditor's requested evidence is spread across shared folders and paper records, making it difficult to check whether everything is complete. We plan to create a central evidence index that identifies the current document, its storage location, and the employee responsible for maintaining it. Please arrange a preparation meeting next week so that we can identify missing records and assign clear deadlines for completing them.

title: Reporting a change in customer demand
text: Customers are increasingly asking for smaller subscription packages, while your sales brochure mainly advertises the largest plan. Speak to the Sales Manager about the situation.
model: Recent customer enquiries show growing demand for smaller subscription packages, especially from businesses that do not need the full range of services. I have summarised the enquiries from the last four weeks and included examples of the features that these customers use most often. Please review whether a smaller package can be offered and update the brochure so that the available choices are clearly explained.

title: Reducing noise from building work
text: Renovation work next to your office is making customer calls difficult during the busiest part of the day. Speak to the Property Manager about the situation.
model: Drilling in the neighbouring unit is making it difficult for our staff to hear customers during the late-morning peak in telephone calls. We suggest scheduling the loudest work before our phone lines open or during the afternoon break, while allowing quieter tasks to continue throughout the day. Please discuss this arrangement with the contractor and share an agreed timetable so that we can plan customer appointments around the work.

title: Booking a demonstration for a school visit
text: A school group will visit your science centre, and the teachers have asked for a practical activity suitable for younger pupils. Speak to the Education Coordinator about the situation.
model: The visiting school group consists of pupils aged nine to eleven, and the teachers would like an activity that all pupils can participate in safely. We propose a simple water-filter experiment using safe household materials, with pupils working in small groups under staff supervision. Please confirm the available demonstration space and staffing so that we can prepare the materials and send the teachers a clear visit plan.

title: Clarifying a warranty exclusion
text: A maintenance provider has rejected a repair claim under a warranty clause that was not explained when your company bought the equipment. Speak to the Service Provider about the situation.
model: Our repair claim was rejected under a warranty exclusion for a component that we understood to be included when the equipment was purchased. The original quotation describes the component as covered, and I have attached that document together with the service provider's rejection notice. Please review the documents and explain the basis for the exclusion, or reconsider the claim if the quotation forms part of the agreed terms.

title: Changing the onboarding schedule
text: The trainer for a new employee induction is unavailable, and the session must be reorganised without leaving new starters idle. Speak to the Onboarding Coordinator about the situation.
model: The trainer is unavailable for the planned induction session, so the new starters cannot complete the original programme on their first morning. We can use that morning for workplace introductions, a building tour, and computer setup, then hold the main training session the following afternoon. Please send the revised schedule to the new starters and their managers and confirm which colleague will supervise the morning activities.

title: Requesting a reference for a former colleague
text: A former colleague has listed you as a professional reference, and you need the hiring company to explain what information it requires. Speak to the Former Team Leader about the situation.
model: I worked closely with the candidate for two years and can provide a professional reference about their responsibilities and performance during that period. Please let me know which skills are relevant to the new role and whether you would prefer a written response to specific questions or a brief telephone discussion. Once the candidate's consent is confirmed, I will arrange a suitable time or return the completed reference form by your stated deadline.

title: Correcting attendance records
text: A completed online course is still marked as incomplete in several employees' training records. Speak to the Training Administrator about the situation.
model: The online course is marked as incomplete for several employees even though they have completed all the modules and passed the final assessment. I have attached their completion certificates and assessment results, along with a list of the affected employee records. Please correct the training records and confirm when the revised status will be visible to the employees and their managers.

title: Changing a customer demonstration format
text: A customer can no longer travel to your office for a product demonstration and has requested an online alternative. Speak to the Account Manager about the situation.
model: The customer is unable to travel for the planned demonstration and has asked whether the same material can be presented in an online session. We can provide a meeting link, test the screen-sharing connection beforehand, and send sample data so that the customer can follow the practical examples. Please confirm the revised format and meeting time with the customer and ask whether any additional participants should receive the invitation.

title: Requesting additional stock before a promotion
text: A planned promotion may use more stock than your branch currently holds, and you need supplies from another branch. Speak to the Stock Controller about the situation.
model: Our current stock is below the forecast demand for the promotion, and a shortage could leave customers unable to buy the advertised product. The nearby branch has enough spare units to cover our forecast shortfall, and a stock transfer would be faster than a new supplier order. Please approve the transfer and confirm when the additional units can arrive so that we can update the promotion display accurately.

title: Reporting a phishing message
text: Several employees received an email pretending to be from payroll and asking them to enter their passwords on an unfamiliar website. Speak to the IT Security Team about the situation.
model: The message claims to be from payroll and asks employees to enter their passwords through a link that does not use our normal company address. We have told staff not to follow the link, to report the message using the security tool, and to delete it after the report is submitted. Please investigate the message, block the sender where appropriate, and circulate a warning if the same attempt has reached other departments.

title: Proposing a shared calendar for equipment
text: Researchers sometimes reserve the same portable testing instrument for different experiments at the same time. Speak to the Laboratory Manager about the situation.
model: Two researchers recently reserved the same portable testing instrument for overlapping experiments because their teams were using separate booking records. A shared calendar with a named owner for every reservation would make availability visible and help us identify conflicts before experiments are planned. Please approve a trial of the shared calendar and nominate a colleague to check reservations and resolve any scheduling conflicts.

title: Requesting a change to an interview time
text: You have been invited to a job interview that clashes with a mandatory examination at your current college. Speak to the Recruitment Team about the situation.
model: The interview time conflicts with a mandatory college examination, and I am unable to leave the examination before the scheduled finish. I remain very interested in the role and would appreciate the opportunity to attend the interview at a different time. I am available on either of the following two afternoons and would be happy to attend online if that would make rescheduling easier.

title: Arranging the return of company equipment
text: An employee who worked remotely is leaving the company and needs a safe way to return their laptop and security token. Speak to the Asset Manager about the situation.
model: The departing employee needs to return a company laptop, its charger, and a security token after their final working day. We propose a tracked courier collection from their home, with suitable protective packaging supplied in advance and a record of the parcel contents. Please confirm the return checklist and coordinate the collection with the access removal process so that the equipment can be checked when it arrives.

title: Notifying customers of planned maintenance
text: A short maintenance window will make your online booking system unavailable on a weekday evening. Speak to the Service Operations Team about the situation.
model: The online booking system will be unavailable during a planned maintenance window from seven to eight on the evening specified in the service notice. Customers who need to make an urgent booking during that hour can contact our telephone team or send an email for manual handling. Please publish a clear notice on the booking page and send an advance message to customers who have appointments affected by the maintenance window.

title: Request for an updated price list
text: You will present a quotation to a new customer, but the price list in your shared folder is no longer current. Speak to the Sales Support Team about the situation.
model: The price list in our shared folder is out of date, and I need the current figures before preparing a quotation for the new customer. Please include the latest unit prices, applicable discounts, tax treatment, and any delivery charges that should appear in the quotation. Could you send the updated list before tomorrow afternoon so that I can check the quotation before the customer presentation?

title: Replacing damaged uniforms
text: Several newly delivered staff uniforms have torn seams, and employees need usable replacements before a public event. Speak to the Store Manager about the situation.
model: Several uniforms in the recent delivery have torn seams, making them unsuitable for staff to wear at the public event. I have listed the affected sizes and quantities and attached photographs showing the damage before any of the uniforms were worn. Please arrange replacements in the correct sizes before the event and confirm how the damaged garments should be returned.

title: Permission to attend an industry conference
text: You would like to attend an industry conference that includes sessions directly related to an upcoming project. Speak to the Department Manager about the situation.
model: The conference includes sessions on the technology we plan to use in our next project, so attending would help us evaluate the available approaches. I have attached an estimate of the registration and travel costs, and a colleague has agreed to cover my urgent work while I am away. Please approve my attendance if the budget allows; I will prepare a short report and share the practical lessons with the team afterwards.

title: Disputed parking charge
text: Your team has received a parking charge for a vehicle that was displaying a valid visitor permit. Speak to the Building Manager about the situation.
model: The vehicle received a parking charge even though a valid visitor permit was displayed for the full period of the meeting. I have attached the permit confirmation, a photograph taken on arrival, and the vehicle registration number so that the record can be checked. Please review the charge with the parking operator and let us know whether it can be cancelled without requiring the visitor to make a separate appeal.

title: Requesting captions for training videos
text: Staff have asked for captions on training videos so that employees with hearing difficulties can use the same material. Speak to the Learning Team about the situation.
model: Our training videos need accurate captions so that employees with hearing difficulties can access the same information as their colleagues. The safety and onboarding videos should be updated first because they contain information that every employee must understand before starting work. Please provide a timeline for adding and checking the captions, including a way for employees to report any errors in the finished material.

title: Complaint about repeated internet interruptions
text: Your office connection has repeatedly failed during working hours, despite a recent repair visit. Speak to the Internet Provider about the situation.
model: The office internet connection has failed several times during working hours since the recent repair visit, disrupting customer calls and online transactions. We have attached an incident log showing the dates, times, and duration of each interruption, together with the reference number from the repair visit. Please investigate the underlying fault and arrange a lasting repair, with a named contact who can keep us informed of progress.

title: Explaining a change to a delivery method
text: Your company must use a courier instead of its usual delivery van because a vehicle has broken down. Speak to the Customer Account Team about the situation.
model: The usual delivery van is unavailable because of a mechanical fault, so we propose using a tracked courier service for the affected orders. The planned delivery dates can still be met, and we will provide tracking information without passing the additional courier cost to the customers. Please notify the affected customers of the change and confirm whether any delivery requires special handling or a different receiving contact.

title: Asking for feedback on a draft policy
text: You have prepared a draft remote-work policy and want managers to identify practical problems before it is finalised. Speak to the Policy Coordinator about the situation.
model: I would like managers to review the draft remote-work policy before it is finalised, with particular attention to how it will work in their departments. Please comment on equipment provision, information security, and the expected availability of staff during agreed working hours. Please return your comments by the end of next week so that we can resolve the main issues before submitting the policy for approval.

title: Seeking a sponsor for a student event
text: A student group is organising a local technology event and wants your company to sponsor the venue costs. Speak to the Community Relations Manager about the situation.
model: The student group is organising a technology event that will give local students practical demonstrations and opportunities to meet employers. They have asked our company to cover part of the venue cost in return for acknowledgement in the event programme and space for a small information stand. Please review the proposal and confirm whether it fits our community budget, or suggest another form of support we could offer.

title: Requesting an extension to a customer survey
text: Your customer survey has too few responses to support the planned analysis, and the closing date is approaching. Speak to the Research Manager about the situation.
model: The customer survey has received fewer responses than expected, which may make the planned comparison between customer groups unreliable. I propose extending the survey by one week and sending a single polite reminder to customers who have not yet responded. Please approve the extension and confirm whether the final report can be delivered one week later than originally agreed.

title: Reporting a misplaced stock label
text: A shelf label in the warehouse points to the wrong product, causing staff to select incorrect items for orders. Speak to the Warehouse Supervisor about the situation.
model: The shelf label identifies the wrong product, and staff have used it to select incorrect items for several orders prepared this morning. We have stopped picking from that shelf, checked the affected orders, and replaced the label after verifying the stock codes against the inventory record. Please arrange a check of the nearby shelves and remind the team to verify product codes whenever labels are moved or replaced.

title: Introducing a new account contact
text: Your customer's usual account contact is moving to another role, and you must introduce the colleague taking over. Speak to the Customer Relationship Team about the situation.
model: The customer's current account contact is moving to another role, and a colleague from the same team will take over responsibility for the account. The outgoing contact will share the open orders, recent decisions, and agreed service commitments so that current work can continue without interruption. Please arrange a short introductory call and send the customer the new colleague's contact details before the handover is completed.

title: Requesting a safer cycle parking area
text: Employees who cycle to work have reported that the bicycle parking area is poorly lit and often full. Speak to the Facilities Director about the situation.
model: Employees have reported that the bicycle parking area is frequently full and poorly lit, especially when they leave after evening shifts. We suggest adding more secure bicycle racks and improving the lighting along the route between the parking area and the building entrance. Please assess the available space and cost of these improvements and tell us whether a temporary solution can be provided while the work is planned.

title: Correcting a customer name on a certificate
text: A customer's name has been misspelled on a course completion certificate that they need for a job application. Speak to the Training Support Team about the situation.
model: The customer's surname is misspelled on their course completion certificate, even though the registration record contains the correct spelling. I have attached the registration confirmation and the customer's correction request so that the name can be checked against the existing record. Please issue a corrected certificate as soon as possible because the customer needs to submit it with a job application later this week.

title: Proposing a simpler approval process
text: Small office purchases are delayed because every request must pass through the same approval process as major equipment orders. Speak to the Process Improvement Lead about the situation.
model: Small routine purchases are taking too long because they follow the same multi-stage approval process used for major equipment orders. We suggest allowing department managers to approve purchases below a clearly defined limit, provided the spending is within an existing budget. Please approve a limited trial with a recorded purchase log and a monthly review so that speed improves without losing financial oversight.

title: Reporting an unexpected laboratory result
text: A laboratory test has produced a result far outside the expected range, and you need guidance before sharing it with the client. Speak to the Research Supervisor about the situation.
model: One test result is far outside the expected range, while the other samples in the same batch are consistent with the earlier measurements. We have repeated the test, checked the instrument calibration, and reviewed the sample label, but the unusual result remains unchanged. Please review the evidence and advise whether further testing is required before we communicate the result to the client.

title: Organising an employee skills exchange
text: Colleagues have useful skills that other employees would like to learn, but the company has no informal sharing programme. Speak to the Team Development Manager about the situation.
model: Several colleagues have offered to share practical skills such as spreadsheet shortcuts, presentation design, and basic troubleshooting with the wider team. We propose one short lunchtime session each month, with voluntary attendance and a simple list of upcoming topics circulated in advance. Please approve the pilot programme and allow us to reserve a room and appoint a coordinator to collect topics and organise speakers.

title: Requesting a backup transport plan
text: A rail strike may prevent staff from reaching a regional customer meeting, so you need an alternative travel plan. Speak to the Travel Coordinator about the situation.
model: The announced rail strike may prevent several employees from reaching the regional customer meeting at the agreed time. A shared minibus is available within the travel budget, while employees who cannot travel could join through a tested video connection. Please confirm which option we should use before the transport reservation deadline so that all participants receive a clear travel plan.

title: Improving the reception queue
text: Visitors have been waiting too long at reception because staff must complete several manual checks for each arrival. Speak to the Customer Experience Manager about the situation.
model: Visitors are waiting too long at reception because each arrival requires several manual checks and the desk handles only one visitor at a time. We suggest allowing hosts to pre-register expected visitors so that reception can prepare badges and complete the remaining identity check more quickly. Please approve a small pilot and measure waiting times and visitor feedback before deciding whether to use the approach throughout the building.

title: Request for a revised research quotation
text: A supplier's research quotation includes services your company does not need and omits a required customer group. Speak to the Market Research Supplier about the situation.
model: The quotation includes telephone interviews that we do not need, while the required group of recently joined customers is missing from the sample. We need an online survey covering both long-standing and recently joined customers, with the results reported separately for each group. Please send a revised proposal showing the updated sample, total cost, and delivery timeline so that we can compare it fairly with the other offers.

title: Restoring access after a role change
text: An employee has moved to a new department but still has access to old folders and cannot open the files needed for the new role. Speak to the Systems Administrator about the situation.
model: The employee still has access to folders from their former department but cannot open several files required for their new responsibilities. The new manager has approved the required permissions, and the former department has confirmed which access rights should be removed. Please update the permissions using the attached approvals and confirm the changes so that the employee can begin work in the new role.

title: Requesting a customer testimonial
text: A satisfied customer has completed a successful project with your team, and you would like permission to quote their feedback. Speak to the Customer Success Manager about the situation.
model: We would like permission to use a short quotation from the customer's positive project feedback in our company case study. The quotation would appear on our website with the customer's company name, and we would send the exact wording for approval before publication. Please contact the customer's authorised representative and record their written permission, including any restrictions on how the quotation may be used.

title: Changing an event registration deadline
text: An event venue needs the final attendance list earlier than expected so that it can prepare visitor passes. Speak to the Events Manager about the situation.
model: The venue now needs our final attendance list three days earlier than expected so that its security team can prepare visitor passes. We should inform everyone invited, send a reminder before the revised deadline, and explain that late registrations may need separate approval. Please approve the revised registration date and confirm how we should handle essential attendees who cannot respond in time.

title: Reporting a broken temperature alarm
text: The temperature alarm in a storage room has failed, although the refrigeration equipment is still working. Speak to the Cold Storage Supervisor about the situation.
model: The temperature alarm is not working, even though the refrigeration unit is maintaining the room within the required range. Until the alarm is repaired, a staff member will record the temperature manually every hour and report any movement outside the safe range. Please arrange an urgent technician visit and confirm whether any additional precautions are required while we rely on manual monitoring.

title: Requesting permission to reuse a photograph
text: You want to use a photograph from a previous company event in a new recruitment brochure. Speak to the Communications Manager about the situation.
model: We would like to reuse a photograph from the previous company event in the new recruitment brochure and its online version. Before publication, we need to check the photographer's licence and confirm that the people shown gave permission for this type of use. Please confirm whether the photograph is cleared for reuse or recommend an alternative image that has the necessary permissions.

title: Organising a service review with a supplier
text: Your cleaning supplier has met some contract targets but repeatedly missed checks in the staff kitchen. Speak to the Contract Manager about the situation.
model: The cleaning supplier has met most contract targets, but the staff kitchen checks have repeatedly been missed during the evening service. Our inspection log includes the dates and photographs of the missed checks, along with the earlier reminders sent to the supplier's supervisor. Please arrange a service review and agree a measurable improvement plan with a follow-up inspection date.

title: Requesting an ergonomic workstation review
text: An employee has reported discomfort while using a desk that was recently moved to a different area. Speak to the Occupational Health Team about the situation.
model: The employee has reported wrist and shoulder discomfort since their desk was moved and the workstation layout changed. We have adjusted the chair and screen position and encouraged regular short breaks, but the employee would benefit from a professional assessment. Please arrange an ergonomic workstation review and advise whether any equipment or further adjustments are needed.

title: Explaining why a lower-cost supplier was rejected
text: Your team selected a more expensive packaging supplier because the cheapest offer did not meet the agreed requirements. Speak to the Procurement Director about the situation.
model: The cheaper packaging did not meet the required strength tests, so it would have increased the risk of damage during transport. The selected supplier also demonstrated more reliable delivery performance, which is essential because the production schedule leaves little spare stock. Although the purchase price is higher, we expect fewer damaged goods and delivery interruptions to reduce the overall cost of using the packaging.

title: Requesting a temporary recruitment freeze exception
text: Your department needs to fill a critical vacancy despite a temporary pause on recruitment across the company. Speak to the HR Director about the situation.
model: The vacant role is essential to maintaining the customer service schedule, and the remaining staff cannot cover it indefinitely without reducing service hours. We have considered redistributing duties and using temporary cover, but neither option provides the required specialist skills within the available budget. Please approve an exception for this vacancy and confirm the evidence required to begin recruitment under the current restrictions.

title: Inviting a customer to test a prototype
text: Your team wants a small group of customers to test a prototype before the final product design is approved. Speak to the Product Research Team about the situation.
model: We would like a small customer group to test the prototype and give feedback before the final design is approved for development. Each participant would attend a one-hour session, complete a few realistic tasks, and agree to keep the unreleased design confidential. Please invite suitable customers, explain the participation requirements, and collect their consent before confirming the testing schedule.

title: Requesting a delivery status update
text: A replacement machine part has not arrived, and a production line cannot restart until it is fitted. Speak to the Supplier Dispatch Team about the situation.
model: The production line cannot restart until the replacement part arrives, so the delay is affecting the day's planned output. The part was ordered under reference 782 and was expected yesterday, but the dispatch confirmation does not include a working tracking number. Please provide the current delivery status and a confirmed arrival time, and tell us whether an expedited shipment is possible.

title: Reporting an error in a customer dashboard
text: A dashboard shows sales totals twice because two data imports included overlapping records. Speak to the Analytics Manager about the situation.
model: The dashboard overstates sales because the latest two data imports contain overlapping records that have been counted twice. We have paused the scheduled report, identified the duplicate records, and informed the colleagues who had already downloaded the affected figures. Please approve a validation check before future imports and confirm who will review the corrected totals before the dashboard is republished.

title: Requesting a larger meeting room
text: More people than expected have accepted an invitation to a client planning workshop. Speak to the Meeting Services Team about the situation.
model: The confirmed attendance is now higher than the capacity of the room originally booked for the client planning workshop. We need a larger room with a projector, movable seating, and space for small-group discussions during the practical planning activity. Please change the reservation and send the new room details so that we can update the invitations before the participants travel.

title: Clarifying responsibility for a shared task
text: Two departments each believed the other was responsible for sending an important customer update. Speak to the Programme Manager about the situation.
model: The customer update was not sent because each department believed the other team was responsible for preparing and issuing it. We have now prepared a joint update and agreed who will send it to the customer after the content is checked. Please assign a named owner for each future update and add the responsibility to the shared delivery checklist.

title: Requesting a replacement access card
text: An employee's access card has been damaged and no longer opens the secure office doors. Speak to the Building Security Team about the situation.
model: The employee's access card is physically damaged and no longer opens the secure doors, although their access permissions have not changed. The manager can confirm the employee's identity, and we have arranged escorted access until a temporary pass or replacement is available. Please deactivate the damaged card and issue a replacement or temporary pass, with instructions for collecting it securely.

points.text: Explain the identity and temporary cover

title: Requesting an updated project risk register
text: Recent supplier and staffing changes may affect your project, but the risk register has not been reviewed for several weeks. Speak to the Project Sponsor about the situation.
model: Recent supplier and staffing changes may affect the project schedule, but the risk register still reflects the assumptions from the previous planning stage. The review should update each risk's likelihood, impact, mitigation plan, and named owner, with particular attention to dependencies on external teams. Please arrange a risk review before the next sponsor meeting so that the project forecast and escalation decisions use current information.

title: Seeking approval for a team skills assessment
text: You need to understand staff skill gaps before buying a new set of technical courses. Speak to the Training Manager about the situation.
model: We would like to assess the team's current skills before buying courses, so that the training budget addresses real gaps rather than repeating familiar material. The assessment would combine a short self-review with a few practical tasks linked to the work employees actually perform. Please approve this approach and confirm how the results should be used to create individual development plans without ranking employees publicly.

title: Reporting an unsafe loading practice
text: A delivery contractor has been unloading heavy boxes without the required lifting equipment. Speak to the Health and Safety Manager about the situation.
model: The contractor unloaded heavy boxes without the required lifting equipment, creating a risk of injury to both their staff and our receiving team. We stopped the unloading activity and asked the contractor to provide the correct equipment before continuing in the designated loading area. Please review the incident with the contractor and confirm the safety briefing and supervision required for future deliveries.

title: Requesting confirmation of a reservation
text: Your company has paid a deposit for a training event, but the hotel has not sent a final booking confirmation. Speak to the Hotel Events Team about the situation.
model: We have paid the deposit for the training event, but we have not yet received a final confirmation covering the room and accommodation reservations. Please verify the event date, number of bedrooms, training-room layout, and audiovisual equipment against the booking form attached to this email. Please send the written confirmation and deposit receipt so that we can issue the participants' travel instructions with confidence.

title: Requesting a product accessibility review
text: Your new mobile application includes small buttons and low-contrast text that may be difficult for some customers to use. Speak to the Design Lead about the situation.
model: The prototype uses small buttons and low-contrast text in several important screens, which may make the application difficult for some customers to use. The review should check text readability, keyboard and assistive-technology navigation, and whether controls remain usable when the display size is increased. Please arrange an accessibility review before development is completed and identify the changes that should be prioritised in the next design revision.

title: Proposing a way to reduce missed appointments
text: Many clients forget their appointments, leaving staff time unused and delaying appointments for other people. Speak to the Clinic Administrator about the situation.
model: A growing number of clients are missing appointments without cancelling, which leaves staff time unused and reduces availability for other clients. We propose sending a simple reminder in advance with a clear way to confirm or cancel the appointment. Please approve a short trial and compare attendance rates, cancellations, and customer feedback before expanding the reminder service.

title: Requesting a customer complaint review
text: A customer complaint has been passed between departments without receiving a clear response. Speak to the Service Quality Team about the situation.
model: The customer's complaint has been passed between several departments, and no single person has taken responsibility for providing a complete response. I have prepared a timeline of the customer's messages and the actions already taken so that the next reviewer can see the full history. Please assign one case owner and agree a response deadline, with a clear escalation route if the proposed resolution cannot be approved.

title: Requesting a change to a purchase order
text: The specification of a component has changed after a purchase order was issued, but the supplier has not yet started production. Speak to the Purchasing Team about the situation.
model: The component specification has changed since the purchase order was issued, and the revised drawing replaces the version originally sent to the supplier. The supplier has confirmed that production has not started, so the change can still be made without discarding completed parts. Please amend the purchase order, send the revised drawing, and obtain written confirmation of any change to the price or delivery date.

title: Thanking a team after an urgent repair
text: A maintenance team worked beyond its normal hours to restore power before your office reopened. Speak to the Service Team Leader about the situation.
model: Your team worked beyond its normal hours to repair the electrical fault and restore power before our office reopened the next morning. This effort allowed us to keep our customer appointments and prevented a full day of disruption to normal office operations. Please pass on our thanks to everyone involved; we would also welcome a short maintenance summary to help us prevent a similar fault.

points.text: Explain the effect of the work

title: Inviting a partner to a planning workshop
text: Your organisation wants a delivery partner to join a workshop about improving a shared customer service process. Speak to the Partner Relations Manager about the situation.
model: We would like your team to join a planning workshop focused on improving the customer service process that our organisations manage together. Please bring recent service data and examples of the issues that create delays or repeated contacts for customers. Please confirm which representatives can attend and whether the proposed workshop date is suitable for your operational team.

title: Requesting a review of a public sign
text: Visitors have repeatedly misunderstood a sign directing them to a temporary entrance during building repairs. Speak to the Visitor Services Manager about the situation.
model: Visitors are following the temporary entrance sign towards a closed corridor, which suggests that the current wording or arrow is unclear. We suggest replacing the sign with a simpler instruction, a clearer arrow, and a small map showing the route from the main gate. Please review the new sign with someone unfamiliar with the building and arrange replacement once the route can be followed without assistance.

title: Requesting a quality check before dispatch
text: A batch of products is ready to leave the factory, but the final inspection record has not been signed. Speak to the Production Manager about the situation.
model: The batch is ready for dispatch, but the final inspection record has not been signed by the authorised quality reviewer. We should hold the shipment until the check is complete, because releasing it now would leave us unable to demonstrate that the required quality controls were followed. Please arrange an authorised reviewer as soon as possible and confirm when the batch can be released to the dispatch team.

title: Requesting a secure file transfer method
text: A customer needs a large confidential design file that is too big for the company's normal email attachments. Speak to the Information Security Manager about the situation.
model: The customer needs a large confidential design file that exceeds the limit for ordinary email attachments. The transfer method should provide encryption, access limited to the named recipient, and an expiry date after which the link stops working. Please recommend an approved file-transfer service and confirm any checks required before we upload the design file.

title: Requesting a revised service-level target
text: Your current response-time target treats routine questions and urgent service failures the same way. Speak to the Service Director about the situation.
model: The current response-time target does not distinguish between routine questions and urgent service failures, so critical cases may wait behind simple enquiries. We propose separate priority categories with a faster response for service failures that prevent customers from operating. Please review the proposed categories and agree realistic response targets with the teams who will be responsible for meeting them.

title: Reporting damaged reusable packaging
text: Reusable transport boxes are returning from customers with damaged hinges, making them unsafe for the next shipment. Speak to the Distribution Manager about the situation.
model: Several reusable transport boxes have returned with damaged hinges, so they cannot safely protect the goods in the next shipment. We have separated the damaged boxes and checked the spare stock, but a shortage may occur unless repairs or replacements are arranged soon. Please arrange inspection of the damaged boxes and agree a repair or replacement plan with the packaging supplier.

title: Requesting a single source for customer documents
text: Sales and support teams are using different versions of the same product document when answering customers. Speak to the Knowledge Manager about the situation.
model: The sales and support teams are using different versions of the product document, which has led to inconsistent answers to customer questions. We suggest a central location for the approved current version, with older files archived and clearly labelled so that they cannot be mistaken for live guidance. Please appoint a document owner and agree the approval process for future changes before we move the files into the shared location.

title: Explaining a cancelled outdoor activity
text: A weather warning makes a planned outdoor staff activity unsuitable, and attendees need a replacement plan. Speak to the Staff Events Team about the situation.
model: The outdoor activity must be cancelled because the weather warning creates a safety risk for participants travelling to and using the site. An indoor team activity is available at the office during the same time slot, so employees can still take part without arranging extra travel. Please inform the attendees of the revised plan and confirm whether any prepaid travel or activity costs can be refunded.

title: Requesting a review of customer consent forms
text: Your new customer registration form collects more personal information than the service appears to need. Speak to the Privacy Officer about the situation.
model: The new registration form requests personal information that does not appear necessary for delivering the service described to customers. Please review whether the full date of birth and home address are required, and whether any remaining optional fields are clearly identified. Please approve a revised form that explains why each required field is collected and records the customer's consent where it is needed.

title: Requesting a rehearsal for a joint presentation
text: Several speakers from different departments will present to a customer, but they have not practised their transitions together. Speak to the Presentation Coordinator about the situation.
model: The presentation includes speakers from several departments, and we need to rehearse the transitions so that the customer sees a clear, coordinated message. The rehearsal should check the total timing, remove repeated content from the slides, and agree who will answer questions about each topic. Please schedule a rehearsal before the customer meeting and ask every speaker to attend with their final slides.

title: Requesting a replacement examination venue
text: The room booked for a staff assessment is next to noisy construction work that will continue on the test day. Speak to the Assessment Coordinator about the situation.
model: The planned assessment room is next to ongoing construction work, and the noise could prevent candidates from hearing instructions or concentrating on their answers. We need a quiet room with enough working computers, reliable internet access, and suitable spacing between candidates. Please confirm an alternative venue and arrange a short equipment check before we send the updated assessment instructions.

title: Requesting approval for a spare-parts reserve
text: Repair work has repeatedly stopped while staff wait for inexpensive replacement parts that are not held in stock. Speak to the Maintenance Manager about the situation.
model: Several repairs have been delayed while we wait for inexpensive replacement parts, even though the repair itself takes only a short time. We propose keeping a small reserve of the most commonly used parts, with minimum stock levels based on the recent maintenance records. Please approve a limited budget for the reserve and review stock use after three months to check that the approach is worthwhile.

title: Requesting a revised quotation for event insurance
text: An event has changed from an indoor meeting to a public outdoor demonstration, so the existing insurance quotation may no longer cover it. Speak to the Insurance Adviser about the situation.
model: The event has changed to a public outdoor demonstration, which introduces risks that were not included in the original indoor-meeting quotation. I have attached the revised attendance estimate, location plan, and list of demonstration equipment for you to review. Please provide a revised quotation and confirm any exclusions or safety conditions that must be met before the event can proceed.

title: Requesting a simpler customer feedback form
text: Customers abandon your feedback form before finishing because it is long and repeats similar questions. Speak to the Customer Insight Team about the situation.
model: Many customers begin the feedback form but do not finish it, and several have said that it is too long and asks similar questions more than once. We suggest a shorter form that keeps the essential service questions and removes repeated or optional questions that do not support a current decision. Please test the revised form with a small customer group and compare completion rates before replacing the existing version.

title: Requesting confirmation of a research data source
text: Two reports give different market figures, and your team needs to decide which source to cite in a client document. Speak to the Research Lead about the situation.
model: The two market reports give different figures for the same period, and the difference is large enough to affect the conclusion in our client document. We should compare the reports' publication dates, definitions, geographical coverage, and collection methods before choosing a figure. Please confirm which source should be cited and whether the final document should explain the difference between the estimates.

title: Requesting support for a first-time supervisor
text: A recently promoted supervisor has strong technical skills but has not previously managed a team. Speak to the Learning and Development Team about the situation.
model: The new supervisor has strong technical experience but needs support with the people-management responsibilities of the role. The most useful initial topics would be giving constructive feedback, delegating work clearly, and handling disagreements within the team. Please recommend suitable training and a mentor, with a short development plan that can be reviewed after the first three months.

title: Requesting a check of a damaged parcel
text: A parcel arrived with a torn outer box and missing contents, and the delivery record shows no damage note. Speak to the Courier Claims Team about the situation.
model: The parcel arrived with a torn outer box, and two items listed on the packing slip were missing when it was opened. I have attached photographs taken on delivery, the packing slip, and the tracking reference so that the shipment can be investigated. Please explain the claim process and confirm whether the missing items can be replaced or their value reimbursed.

title: Requesting a change to an induction checklist
text: New employees receive conflicting instructions about when to complete their identity check and collect equipment. Speak to the HR Operations Team about the situation.
model: The induction checklist and the welcome email give different instructions about the order of the identity check and equipment collection. New employees have arrived at the wrong desk and waited unnecessarily because the teams expected the steps to happen in a different order. Please align the two documents and confirm the agreed sequence with reception, Human Resources, and the equipment team.

title: Requesting a review of a long customer contract
text: A customer has proposed several changes to a contract shortly before the planned project start date. Speak to the Legal Team about the situation.
model: The customer has proposed several contract changes shortly before the planned project start date, and we need to understand their effect before accepting them. The main changes concern liability, payment timing, and the customer's right to end the agreement before the project is completed. Please review the marked-up contract and identify which changes we can accept and which should be discussed with the customer before work begins.

title: Requesting an overflow plan for a busy season
text: Forecast demand during the holiday season is higher than the capacity of your usual processing team. Speak to the Operations Director about the situation.
model: The forecast demand for the holiday season is higher than the capacity of the usual processing team, so delays are likely without extra support. We propose using cross-trained staff from a quieter department and temporary support for simple tasks, while keeping complex cases with experienced employees. Please approve the overflow plan and its budget so that training and scheduling can be completed before demand increases.

title: Requesting a review of a product return trend
text: Returns of one product have increased, and customers are reporting the same problem with its power button. Speak to the Product Quality Manager about the situation.
model: Returns of this product have increased, and many customers describe the same problem with the power button becoming difficult to operate. We have grouped the return reports by production batch and kept several returned samples for inspection to help identify whether the fault is widespread. Please investigate the samples and recommend any corrective action, including guidance for the customer support team while the review is in progress.

title: Requesting a review of an international meeting schedule
text: A recurring meeting time requires one overseas team to join very late at night every week. Speak to the Programme Coordinator about the situation.
model: The recurring meeting time requires the overseas team to join late at night every week, while the other teams attend during normal office hours. We suggest rotating the meeting time and sharing a written summary or recording so that the same team does not always carry the inconvenience. Please consult the participating teams and agree a revised schedule that still provides enough overlap for important joint decisions.

title: Requesting a correction to a product label
text: A draft product label shows an old ingredient list even though the formulation has recently changed. Speak to the Regulatory Affairs Team about the situation.
model: The draft label still shows the old ingredient list, while the formulation approved for the next production batch includes a recent change. We should hold printing and product release until the text has been checked, because customers must receive accurate information about the product contents. Please review the updated formulation, correct the label, and provide written approval before the packaging supplier begins printing.

title: Requesting approval for a customer knowledge session
text: Customers repeatedly ask the same setup questions, and your team wants to run a short online guidance session. Speak to the Account Director about the situation.
model: Customers repeatedly ask the same setup questions, which suggests that a short guided session could help them begin using the service more confidently. The session would demonstrate the initial setup steps, explain common mistakes, and leave time for questions using a realistic example account. Please approve a pilot session and invite a small customer group so that we can collect feedback before offering it more widely.

title: Requesting a review of a handover between shifts
text: Important unresolved issues are sometimes omitted from the handover between the evening and morning teams. Speak to the Shift Manager about the situation.
model: Several unresolved issues were omitted from the shift handover, so the morning team had to repeat checks that the evening team had already completed. We suggest a short standard record showing each open issue, its current status, the person responsible, and the next action required. Please trial the record with both shifts and review whether it improves continuity without adding unnecessary paperwork.

title: Requesting approval for a secure disposal service
text: Old customer files have reached the end of their retention period and must be destroyed securely. Speak to the Records Officer about the situation.
model: The listed customer files have reached the end of their approved retention period and no longer need to be kept for normal business purposes. We propose using the approved secure shredding service and obtaining a destruction certificate that identifies the collection date and records covered. Please confirm that no legal hold applies and approve the disposal before we arrange collection of the sealed record boxes.

points.text: Explain the records to dispose of

title: Requesting a revised business continuity exercise
text: Your last emergency exercise assumed everyone was in the office, but most staff now work partly from home. Speak to the Continuity Manager about the situation.
model: The previous continuity exercise assumed that all staff were in the office, which no longer reflects how our teams work across home and office locations. A revised exercise should test remote internet failure, access to critical systems, and the process for contacting staff when normal communication channels are unavailable. Please plan an updated exercise and involve the remote team representatives so that the response arrangements can be tested realistically.

title: Requesting a revised customer appointment process
text: Customers are being offered appointment slots before technicians have confirmed their travel availability. Speak to the Service Scheduling Team about the situation.
model: Customers are receiving confirmed appointment slots before the technicians' travel availability has been checked, leading to avoidable rescheduling. We should check the technicians' shared calendar and travel time before confirming a slot, with provisional holds used only when the customer understands the condition. Please update the booking procedure and brief the scheduling team so that new appointments follow the agreed sequence.

title: Requesting support for an employee relocation
text: An employee is moving to another branch and needs clear information about travel, housing support, and the first working day. Speak to the HR Support Team about the situation.
