model: The employee is preparing to move to the new branch and needs clear information about the support available during the transition. Please explain the approved travel arrangements, any temporary housing support, and the confirmed first working day at the new location. Please nominate a contact at each branch and share a relocation checklist so that equipment, access, and reporting arrangements are ready in time.

title: Requesting a review of an unsuccessful tender
text: Your company did not win a tender and wants constructive feedback to improve future proposals. Speak to the Bid Manager about the situation.
model: We would appreciate feedback on our unsuccessful tender so that we can understand how to improve the clarity and competitiveness of future proposals. It would be particularly useful to understand how our technical response, delivery plan, and pricing compared with the published evaluation criteria. Please let us know whether a short feedback meeting or a written summary can be provided, within the information you are permitted to share.

title: Requesting a review of an automatic email reminder
text: An automatic reminder is being sent to customers who have already completed the action it requests. Speak to the Customer Communications Team about the situation.
model: The automatic reminder is being sent to some customers who have already completed the requested action, creating confusion and unnecessary support contacts. The customer status appears to update after the reminder list is generated, so the system may be using information that is no longer current. Please check the timing of the status update and stop incorrect reminders while a reliable correction is tested.

title: Requesting a public transport benefit review
text: Staff have asked whether the company can offer a public transport benefit to reduce the cost of commuting. Speak to the Employee Benefits Manager about the situation.
model: Employees have asked whether a public transport benefit could help reduce commuting costs and make alternatives to driving more practical. Possible options include a season-ticket loan, a negotiated travel discount, or support for employees whose shifts fall outside normal service hours. Please review these options and gather staff preferences before recommending an approach that fits the benefits budget.

title: Requesting a review of equipment instructions
text: Staff are using an older operating guide for equipment that received a recent software update. Speak to the Technical Documentation Team about the situation.
model: The operating guide in the shared folder describes the old software interface, while the equipment now uses the updated version installed last week. Several screen names and settings have changed, so new users cannot reliably follow the existing step-by-step instructions. Please revise the guide with current screenshots and mark the old version as withdrawn so that staff can identify the correct instructions.

title: Requesting a revised delivery forecast
text: A supplier has warned of a material shortage, and your production forecast still assumes the original delivery schedule. Speak to the Supply Planning Team about the situation.
model: The supplier has warned of a material shortage that may affect the next deliveries, while our production forecast still assumes the original schedule. We need confirmed quantities and dates for the next shipments, together with the stock already available and any approved substitute material. Please update the delivery forecast and propose which customer orders should be prioritised if the shortage cannot be resolved in time.

title: Requesting a review of a donation policy
text: Employees want to collect money for an emergency appeal, and you need to check the company's rules before starting. Speak to the Community Programme Team about the situation.
model: Employees would like to organise a voluntary collection for the emergency appeal and have asked whether the company can support the activity. We propose using a verified charity, keeping participation voluntary, and recording the transfer with a receipt so that the collection remains transparent. Please confirm the relevant policy and tell us whether permission or donation matching is available before we announce the collection.

title: Requesting a review of an account closure
text: A customer account was closed while an unresolved billing dispute was still being investigated. Speak to the Customer Support Supervisor about the situation.
model: The customer account was closed even though the billing dispute was still being investigated, which has prevented the customer from viewing their records. We should restore limited access to the records and pause any further action on the disputed amount while the investigation continues. Please review how the closure was triggered and confirm the correct process for resolving the dispute before any final account closure.

title: Requesting approval for a repair instead of replacement
text: A damaged office chair can be repaired for much less than the cost of buying a new one. Speak to the Asset Committee about the situation.
model: The damaged chair can be repaired by replacing its adjustment mechanism, and the frame has passed the supplier's safety inspection. The repair quotation is considerably lower than the price of a suitable replacement, and the repaired part would carry a service warranty. Please approve the repair if it meets our asset policy and confirm how the warranty details should be recorded after the work is completed.

title: Requesting a review of a subscription cancellation
text: Your company cancelled a software subscription before the renewal date but has still received a renewal invoice. Speak to the Vendor Accounts Team about the situation.
model: We cancelled the subscription before the renewal deadline and received an acknowledgement, but a new annual renewal invoice has still been issued. I have attached the cancellation acknowledgement and the original request, both of which show the date and account reference. Please withdraw the renewal invoice or issue the appropriate credit and confirm that the subscription will not renew again.

title: Requesting a review of a volunteer rota
text: A community event rota assigns some volunteers to long shifts without a break while other shifts have more people than needed. Speak to the Volunteer Coordinator about the situation.
model: The current rota gives some volunteers long shifts without a planned break, while other time slots have more volunteers than the activities require. We suggest redistributing the shifts, including regular breaks, and ensuring that each activity has enough trained cover throughout the event. Please revise the rota and confirm the changes with the volunteers before sending the final event instructions.

title: Requesting a review of a website checkout problem
text: Customers using mobile phones cannot complete a purchase because the payment button is partly hidden on small screens. Speak to the Digital Services Manager about the situation.
model: The payment button is partly hidden on smaller mobile screens, which prevents some customers from completing the checkout process. We have reproduced the problem on several devices and attached screenshots with the browser and screen-size details from each test. Please prioritise a correction and test the revised checkout on the affected devices before releasing it to customers.

title: Requesting approval for a document scanning project
text: Frequently used paper records are stored far from the main office, causing staff to spend time retrieving them. Speak to the Office Administration Manager about the situation.
model: Staff spend considerable time retrieving frequently used paper records from off-site storage whenever a customer enquiry requires them. We propose scanning the most frequently requested records into a searchable folder with access limited to authorised employees. Please approve a small pilot and compare the retrieval time, scanning cost, and information-security requirements before extending the project.

title: Requesting a review of a product launch checklist
text: The product team and customer support team use separate launch checklists, and an important support briefing was missed. Speak to the Launch Coordinator about the situation.
model: The customer support briefing was missed because the product and support teams use separate launch checklists with no shared confirmation step. A shared launch milestone should name the owner of the briefing and require confirmation that support materials and staff training are ready. Please update the launch process before the next release and arrange a joint check of the remaining readiness tasks.

title: Requesting a review of a delivery route
text: Drivers report that a recently changed delivery route adds unnecessary distance and crosses a road with repeated restrictions. Speak to the Fleet Manager about the situation.
model: The revised delivery route adds unnecessary distance and crosses a road that frequently has access restrictions, making arrival times less predictable. Drivers have suggested an alternative route that avoids the restricted road and appears to reduce travel time during the main delivery period. Please compare the routes using recent journey records and arrange a trial before deciding whether to change the permanent delivery plan.

title: Requesting a review of a damaged training kit
text: A practical training kit has missing parts and cannot be used for the next group of learners. Speak to the Training Equipment Team about the situation.
model: The practical training kit is missing several small components that are essential for completing the scheduled exercises safely. We have checked the kit against its inventory list and identified exactly which components need to be replaced before the next session. Please arrange the missing parts or a loan kit and confirm whether it will be ready before the next learner group arrives.

title: Requesting a review of a shared inbox process
text: Messages in a shared inbox are sometimes answered twice and sometimes left unanswered because staff cannot see who is handling them. Speak to the Customer Operations Manager about the situation.
model: The shared inbox contains messages that have received duplicate replies and others that remain unanswered because ownership is not visible. We suggest assigning each message to a named colleague and using clear status labels for new, in-progress, and completed enquiries. Please trial the method and review response times and duplicate replies before choosing a permanent shared-inbox process.

title: Requesting a review of course prerequisite information
text: Employees registered for a course without realising that it requires knowledge of a software tool they have never used. Speak to the Training Provider about the situation.
model: Several employees registered for the course without realising that prior knowledge of the software was required, because the prerequisite was not clear in the course listing. We would like an introductory session or preparation material that covers the essential software skills before the main course begins. Please update the course listing and confirm which preparation option you can provide so that we can advise the registered employees.

title: Requesting a review of an external link in a report
text: A client report contains a link to a document that is no longer available, so readers cannot check an important claim. Speak to the Editorial Manager about the situation.
model: The report links to a document that is no longer available, leaving readers unable to verify an important claim in the recommendations. We have identified a current source supporting the same point and checked that its definitions and reporting period match the report. Please replace the reference and issue a corrected version, with a short notice to the readers who received the original report.

title: Requesting a review of a visitor group booking
text: A large group has booked a tour that exceeds the safe capacity for one guide in the exhibition area. Speak to the Visitor Booking Team about the situation.
model: The booked group is larger than the safe capacity for one guide in the exhibition area, especially at the narrow points on the tour route. We suggest splitting the visitors into two smaller groups with separate guides and slightly staggered starting times. Please confirm whether two guides are available and send the revised schedule to the group organiser before the visit.

title: Requesting a review of a time-zone setting
text: Appointment confirmations show the wrong local time for customers booking from another country. Speak to the Business Systems Team about the situation.
model: The appointment confirmation shows our office time without converting it to the customer's local time, which has caused confusion for customers in another country. The confirmation should clearly show the customer's local time and the relevant time zone, with the office time included only where it helps staff coordinate. Please correct the time-zone handling and test bookings from the affected country before the next appointment reminders are sent.

title: Requesting approval for a lessons-learned meeting
text: A project has finished with both successful outcomes and avoidable delays, and the team wants to capture useful lessons. Speak to the Project Manager about the situation.
model: We would like to review the completed project so that the successful practices can be reused and the avoidable delays can be addressed in future work. The meeting should focus on planning assumptions, communication between teams, and the decisions that had the greatest effect on the schedule. Please schedule a short lessons-learned meeting and record a small set of practical actions with named owners after the discussion.
